messages:
Priya (AE): FYI — OrionAI wants API + Optimize + Console bundle. Requesting 38% off, 18mo commit, BYOK + SOC2 before go-live, and a hard overage cap at +20%. Hoping to close this month.

Tom (SE): POC numbers: API ~600k tokens/mo, spikes to 1.1M; Optimize ~12k jobs/mo; Console heavy during onboarding. No residency issues. BYOK preferred.

Rina (Deal Desk): 38% is above policy. Typical max on bundles is 30% for 1.5x commit. 35% needs 2.0x commit + CRO sign-off. Overage cap concessions require RevOps.

Oscar (Eng-Security): We can provide SOC2 report. Hosted BYOK is not GA. Options: Dedicated deployment (lead time ~6 weeks) or KMS escrow (legal review). Need to confirm if customer will accept Dedicated lead time.

Hannah (Product): Console retention default 180d. We can grant 90d as concession. Note: aggressive caps on overages might need throttling behavior documented.

Eli (Legal): I can draft an escrow/KMS clause and overage addendum. Define key rotation, access, termination behavior. Also need deletion SLA (customer asked for 7 days).

Mark (CRO): Looping in. 38% requires my approval + RevOps pricing model. If they meet 2.0x commit we can consider 35% with exec sign-off. Send final ARR & POC artifacts.

Priya (AE): Proposed counter I'm submitting: 35% discount, 18mo (2.0x) commit, Dedicated for BYOK with 6wk delivery SLA, SOC2, 90d Console retention, overage cap +15%. Include 1st-year PS onboarding.

Rina (Deal Desk): I'll start exception workflow. Need exact ACV, discount %, commit multiple, infra delivery SLA, and legal text. RevOps will validate billing: input vs output token counting for the API.

Tom (SE): Also confirm monthly measurement window for overage and whether burst credits apply. If Dedicated, ops will require a baseline infra fee — flag that in SOW.

Eli (Legal): Send security questionnaire link and the final commercial terms. I'll prepare the KMS escrow draft and deletion SLA language.

Priya (AE): On it. Uploading docs now and will update thread. Will push customer to accept 35% + PS. :thumbsup:
